The '''Tendrando Refueling and Repair Station''' was an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] owned by [[Tendrando Arms]] and used for refueling and servicing [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The base orbited [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], when it was also decommissioned.
